" type="audio/mpeg"/></audio><div aria-label="Controles de música" class="music-controls hidden" id="music-controls" role="group"><button aria-label="Pausar música" class="music-toggle" id="music-toggle" title="Pausar música" type="button">♫  Pausar música</button></div><script>
const weddingAudio = document.getElementById('wedding-audio');
const musicControls = document.getElementById('music-controls');
const musicToggle = document.getElementById('music-toggle');
function showMusicButton(){musicControls.classList.remove('hidden');}
function updateMusicButton(){
  if(weddingAudio.paused){musicToggle.textContent='♫  Activar música';musicToggle.setAttribute('aria-label','Activar música');}
  else{musicToggle.textContent='♫  Pausar música';musicToggle.setAttribute('aria-label','Pausar música');}
}
let invitationOpening = false;
function openInvite(){
  if(invitationOpening)return;
  invitationOpening=true;
  const cover=document.getElementById('cover');
  // Keep the audio.play() inside the click gesture; browsers require this.
  const finishOpening=()=>{
    cover.classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('invitation').classList.remove('hidden');
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
  };
  if(window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){finishOpening();}
  else{cover.classList.add('cover-opening');window.setTimeout(finishOpening,550);}
  // Clicking the envelope is a user gesture, so supported browsers can play immediately.
  if(weddingAudio){
    showMusicButton();
    updateMusicButton();
    // The user's tap on "Abrir invitación" authorizes sound in supported browsers.
    const attempt=weddingAudio.play();
    if(attempt && typeof attempt.then==='function'){
      attempt.then(updateMusicButton).catch(updateMusicButton);
    }
  }
}
musicToggle.addEventListener('click',function(){
  if(weddingAudio.paused){weddingAudio.play().then(updateMusicButton).catch(updateMusicButton);}
  else{weddingAudio.pause();updateMusicButton();}
});
weddingAudio.addEventListener('playing',()=>{showMusicButton();updateMusicButton();});
weddingAudio.addEventListener('pause',updateMusicButton);
weddingAudio.addEventListener('error',()=>{showMusicButton();musicToggle.textContent='♫  Música no disponible';musicToggle.setAttribute('aria-label','Música no disponible');});
function demoRSVP(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const name=document.getElementById('guest').value.trim();
  const choice=document.querySelector('input[name="attendance"]:checked');
  const msg=document.getElementById('message').value.trim();
  const result=document.getElementById('result');
  if(!name||!choice)return;
  result.classList.remove('hidden');
  result.textContent=(choice.value==='Sí asistiré'?'¡Qué alegría, '+name+'!':'Gracias por avisarnos, '+name+'.')+(msg?' Tu mensaje: “'+msg+'”.':'')+' Esta es una vista previa; la respuesta aún no ha sido enviada.';
}

// Reveal content as guests scroll. Never hide content if animations are unsupported.
(function initScrollAnimations(){
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window) || window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return;
  const items=document.querySelectorAll('#invitation section .inner, #invitation section.hero, #fotos .photo-pair img, #fotos .extra-photos img, #fotos .new-photo-gallery img, #celebracion .panel, #vestimenta .palette, #vestimenta .avoid-colors, #confirmar .rsvp');
  items.forEach((el,i)=>{el.classList.add('motion-item');if(el.matches('#fotos img'))el.style.transitionDelay=((i%3)*95)+'ms';});
  const observer=new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('motion-visible');observer.unobserve(entry.target);}});
  },{threshold:.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -24px 0px'});
  items.forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
  document.documentElement.classList.add('motion-ready');
})();
</script>
<script>
// Contador en hora local de Quito (UTC−05:00), no en la zona horaria del visitante.
(function(){
 const target=new Date('2027-01-23T18:00:00-05:00').getTime();
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
 function tick(){
  let remaining=Math.max(0,target-Date.now());
  const d=Math.floor(remaining/86400000);remaining%=86400000;
  const h=Math.floor(remaining/3600000);remaining%=3600000;
  const m=Math.floor(remaining/60000);remaining%=60000;
  const sec=Math.floor(remaining/1000);
  $('count-days').textContent=d;$('count-hours').textContent=String(h).padStart(2,'0');$('count-minutes').textContent=String(m).padStart(2,'0');$('count-seconds').textContent=String(sec).padStart(2,'0');
  $('countdown-status').textContent=Date.now()>=target?'¡Llegó nuestro gran día!':'';
 }
 tick();setInterval(tick,1000);
 const ics=['BEGIN:VCALENDAR','VERSION:2.0','PRODID:-//Carolina y Daniel//Invitacion de boda//ES','CALSCALE:GREGORIAN','BEGIN:VEVENT','UID:carolina-daniel-20270123@invitacion','DTSTAMP:20261110T000000Z','DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20270123','DTEND;VALUE=DATE:20270124','SUMMARY:Boda de Carolina y Daniel','LOCATION:Hotel Mercure Alameda Quito, Quito, Ecuador','DESCRIPTION:Ceremonia 18:00 en Salon Alamos. Recepcion 20:00 en Salon Cipreses.','END:VEVENT','END:VCALENDAR'].join('\r\n');
 $('download-ics').addEventListener('click',function(){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([ics],{type:'text/calendar;charset=utf-8'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='Boda_Carolina_y_Daniel.ics';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);});
 // Vista previa de personalización con parámetros del enlace, sin guardar datos.
 const p=new URLSearchParams(location.search);const guest=(p.get('nombre')||'Flor y Alfredo').trim().slice(0,120);const rawPasses=p.get('pases')||'2';const passes=rawPasses!==null?Number(rawPasses):NaN;
 if(guest){
  $('personalizacion').classList.remove('hidden');
  $('cover-personal').classList.remove('hidden');
  $('guest-greeting').textContent=guest;
  $('cover-guest-name').textContent=guest;
  const input=$('guest');if(input){input.value=guest;input.readOnly=true;}
  if(Number.isInteger(passes)&&passes>=1&&passes<=30){
    const countText=passes+' '+(passes===1?'pase reservado':'pases reservados');
    $('guest-passes').textContent='Hemos reservado '+passes+' '+(passes===1?'pase':'pases')+' en su honor.';
    $('cover-pass-count').textContent=countText;
    $('rsvp-personal').textContent='Invitación para '+guest+' · '+countText;
    $('rsvp-personal').classList.remove('hidden');
  }
}
})();
</script>
